about: The orb, the great lit sphere on the Las Vegas map: the hum of its skin of lamps, heard at the nearest point of the sphere.
notes: Asked 2026-11-24. No take is made yet, so there is no sounds.json here: the cue orb/hum plays core:tech/sound/obelisk at 0.8 of its rate until this slot has one (shared/sound/cues.ts). The hum should be low, plain mains, with no shimmer and no pulse, so that it does not pass for a Tide Eye or a drop's shaft.

prompts.text: A vast wall of electric lamps and their power supplies hums: a low steady mains hum with a faint electrical buzz over it and soft fan air beneath, constant and unchanging. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
